channel.title: Writing on AI products and business | Ahmadreza Samadi
channel.description: Read Ahmadreza Samadi on building AI products, testing them on real tasks and counting review costs. Explore property examples and everyday technology explainers.
channel.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: I build AI, and I run a business that has to live with it
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi builds AI at Appraiva and runs Royal Abraj Group in Dubai. Three questions for deciding where AI belongs in a business, and where it must stop.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI property briefs: A tidy property brief still needs evidence.
item.description: Review an AI-generated property brief slide by slide. Trace each important claim to its source, identify missing evidence and decide what still needs checking.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How to check a Dubai broker record | Ahmadreza Samadi
item.description: Follow a Dubai broker record check through the official listing. See which details identify the broker and which property and transaction facts need separate checks.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai procedure status: Submitted is a stage, not the finish.
item.description: Read a Dubai procedure status in context. Follow the slides to distinguish what the record currently shows from the outcome someone expects to happen next.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai project status and registration | Ahmadreza Samadi
item.description: Match a Dubai project to its registered record before reading a progress update. Use the slides to check that the evidence describes the same project.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai rental index and asking rents | Ahmadreza Samadi
item.description: Compare a Dubai asking rent with an official rental index result. Keep the property details, advertised price and index evidence distinct as you read each slide.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai property valuation: Ask what produced the property number.
item.description: Compare property valuation evidence in Dubai. Identify the type of value, its source and the purpose of the comparison before relying on a figure for a decision.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: An AI factory needs more than GPUs.
item.description: NVIDIA announced Minerva, an AIOps platform connecting infrastructure and workload signals. The trend is visibility across the whole operation.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: What a Gemini business hub can do | Ahmadreza Samadi
item.description: Google announced a Gemini landing page for small businesses, with brand, finance and connected-app tools. Start with the workflow you need.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: A chat request is not a shipped fix.
item.description: GitHub announced a consolidated Teams app that connects issue notifications with Copilot. The review step still belongs in the workflow.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: World models and real-world tests | Ahmadreza Samadi
item.description: NVIDIA expanded Cosmos with data, training and simulation tools for physical AI. Generated scenarios can broaden what developers test.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: More agents. The same queue.
item.description: In a fictional dispatch library, every helper needs the same key. Follow the queue to see which tasks an extra agent can take on and which still have to wait.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Before buying a new machine, find where the energy goes
item.description: A fictional building manager investigates a high energy bill. Follow the audit questions about equipment and daily operation before deciding what to replace.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The sale happened. The cash is still on its way.
item.description: Follow a fictional lamp workshop from buying inventory to collecting cash. See why a recorded sale and cash available to pay a bill can fall on different days.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The form was perfect. The answer was wrong.
item.description: Follow Noor as she checks a delivery date against a supplier quote. A fictional example shows how an AI response can fit its schema and still get a fact wrong.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI wrote the result. People still need to understand it.
item.description: Zara reviews an AI-generated research result. Follow her questions about the evidence, assumptions and limitations behind a polished answer in this fictional case.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI usage and useful business outcomes | Ahmadreza Samadi
item.description: GitHub has expanded Copilot usage reporting across tools. That helps show activity. It does not measure business results by itself.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The AI demo passed. The real work did not.
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains why a polished AI demonstration does not establish reliability for the real task: choose evaluation cases from the work.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI agents are learning when to ask.
item.description: GitHub has made assisted permissions generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code. The useful question is what still needs your approval.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The document tried to become the boss
item.description: A fictional theatre shows why a document should not control an AI assistant. Fewer tools, content checks and human approval can limit misleading instructions.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: A beautiful building model can still be out of date
item.description: In a fictional office, Omar sees a polished building model while a room feels wrong. Check which physical asset the data describes and when it was observed.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Next door is not always comparable
item.description: Fictional buyer Mina compares neighbouring flats: one asking price and one older agreed sale. Nearby doors do not make them identical valuation evidence.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The button moved. The AI did not notice.
item.description: In a fictional parcel studio, Nora asks an AI helper for a label. A panel moves before the click arrives: the cursor moves, but the label is still missing.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The money has a project name
item.description: Fictional buyer Rami sees a model of an unfinished building and asks which records support its payment instructions. No real project or account is represented.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The confident answer from the old price list
item.description: In a fictional hotel, Leila asks an AI assistant for a meeting-room quote. Before sending its fluent answer, she checks the source and finds an old price list.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai service charge: same rent, different bills
item.description: A fictional Dubai comparison by Ahmadreza Samadi separates advertised rent from cash after service charges, with DLD’s definition and limits.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI agents: ability is not authority
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi uses a fictional invoice to explain business AI permissions: the boundaries between reading, drafting and approving an action.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How cold outdoor air can help warm a home
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains how a heat pump moves heat through a fictional home and an illustrative energy balance, with an English animated film.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AVM vs appraisal: which fits your decision?
item.description: Compare an automated valuation, a broker opinion and an appraisal. See how missing sales, uncertain property condition and the intended use affect the choice.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai property buying costs, item by item
item.description: Build a dated Dubai purchase budget from official registration fees, mortgage charges and your own quotes. Separate total fees from the buyer’s share.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Where the person signs off: property AI review
item.description: A practical human-review checklist for property AI: define the decision, check evidence, preserve uncertainty and record who can approve the next action.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Rent or buy: the five numbers that decide it
item.description: Compare rent and ownership using matched housing, running costs, upfront cash, time and net exit proceeds. Keep cash affordability separate from wealth.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Tesla says Roadster can fly: three questions to ask
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi’s fictional hangar explains thrust and separates a manufacturer’s Tesla Roadster claim from availability and public-road approval.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI agents need shared notes, and a way to check them
item.description: A fictional repair workshop explains reusable agent knowledge, context checks and a boundary for private project information.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why your phone puts you across the street
item.description: A fictional pickup explains reflected satellite signals, an uncertain map dot and a practical way to agree where to meet.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: A map answer. The right place?
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi’s geospatial AI checklist: check the boundary, date, source and assumptions behind a map answer; keep unsupported conclusions open.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Your thermostat speaks. Who listens?
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains BACnet building integration: identify the devices, data and commands, and who verifies that they work together.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: The message looks convincing.
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains AI scam warnings: stop a rushed action, verify through a trusted separate contact route and keep uncertainty visible.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Dubai property costs and data: choose the right source
item.description: Choose Dubai property sources by purpose: sale and mortgage fees, rental benchmarks, sales-price indices or a specific valuation. Keep dates and limits visible.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Where does your wearable’s AI run?
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains wearable AI computation: which tasks run locally, what data is sent out and what happens without a connection.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Your building sent an alert.
item.description: A fictional building leak alert shows why a named responder, a location check and a recorded outcome matter. Three questions to ask before buying a sensor.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Who checks the AI’s homework?
item.description: A document-review checklist by Ahmadreza Samadi: write the claim, locate its supporting evidence, then resolve the gap or keep it visible.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How a virtual PC can use your real printer
item.description: Our original checklist: Which virtual PC? Which resources? Do I need each one? The film is conceptual, not product footage or a tested setup.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why did the lights go out while you were there?
item.description: Why occupancy sensors can miss a seated person: check their view, movement detection and timeout before asking the facilities team to investigate.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why dividing metro rent by home value does not give property yield
item.description: Why a metro rent-to-value ratio is not an observed property yield. A fictional cash budget shows the difference and the next evidence to check.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does AI need weather stations?
item.description: AI weather models need current observations as well as past patterns. Check location, update time and forecast window, and distinguish radar from forecasts.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How does a laser scan become a building record?
item.description: Use a scan as evidence for a defined question. It does not certify structural safety, hidden services or universal accuracy. No real building was scanned.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does moving data matter for AI chips?
item.description: Our original framework: identify the workload, locate the bottleneck, then test the complete result. No chip test, measured saving or vendor ranking is claimed.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: What makes a building ready for AI data centers?
item.description: Power, cooling, networks and building fit explained through fictional sites, with current JLL and Meta sources and questions for specialist review.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How can a smaller AI model fit a useful task?
item.description: Haiku 5.5 is a current example of narrow AI work. Learn task definition, evaluation, routing and a fictional cost calculation without assuming equal quality.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How do property tokens work, and can you sell them?
item.description: A simple property-token explainer connects digital ownership, fractional shares and net rent with the separate challenge of finding a buyer.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How does ChatGPT's Intelligent UI work?
item.description: Explore ChatGPT's interactive answers using a fictional budget. Changing a number shows what the interface can calculate and which assumptions still need checking.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How can a building have a live digital copy?
item.description: Sensors connect real rooms and equipment to an updating digital model. See how a building digital twin turns readings into useful context.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How does property data enrichment connect the right records?
item.description: A fictional image-and-record comparison shows how to check property identity, source dates and unresolved claims before combining property information.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How many coffees must a cafe sell before it makes any profit?
item.description: A fictional café sells 100 coffees for $500 and earns no operating profit. Follow the price, variable cost per cup and fixed costs to calculate its break-even point.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why can AI lose track of something you already said?
item.description: Your chat history can contain details the model no longer sees. Compare the context window, summaries and saved memory to understand why a chatbot misses a detail.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why is Wi-Fi slow even with full bars?
item.description: Full Wi-Fi bars measure signal strength between your device and router. Compare local congestion, the internet connection and the service to locate the slowdown.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How does a contactless card work without a battery?
item.description: Trace a contactless payment from the reader's radio field to the card's chip. See how a tap supplies power and carries payment data back to the terminal.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How do headphones cancel noise by making more sound?
item.description: Microphones measure outside noise and a speaker adds a carefully timed opposite wave. Why this reduces a hum better than every sudden voice.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How does your phone turn text in a photo into copyable words?
item.description: OCR finds text regions and recognises visual patterns as letters and words. The AI feature can save typing, but copied text still needs checking.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why do identical-looking USB-C cables behave differently?
item.description: Two USB-C cables can look alike and support different charging power, data speeds or video. Check what the cable, charger and device support before choosing one.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: iPhone Duo: what does the extra $800 cost per day?
item.description: Compare the $800 US launch-price gap by day of ownership. Check the installment example and see how an uncertain resale value affects the cost calculation.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why can 8% rental yield still leave a cash shortfall?
item.description: A correct rental-yield calculation can still leave a cash shortfall. Follow a fictional home from headline yield to money left after costs and the loan.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does your computer slow down when storage is almost full?
item.description: See why a nearly full drive leaves less room for temporary files, memory overflow and SSD housekeeping. These examples explain when freeing space can help.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How can a profitable business run out of cash?
item.description: A profitable sale can leave a business unable to pay its supplier. Follow one order to see why earned money and available cash are different.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Does Incognito actually make you invisible?
item.description: When you close an Incognito window, what disappears from your device? Follow a gift purchase through browser history, cookies, saved files and website records.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: What does Accept cookies actually mean?
item.description: The same small browser note can remember your shopping basket or help a company recognise you across websites. The choice is about what that note does.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does AI sound so confident when it is wrong?
item.description: Ahmadreza Samadi explains confident AI mistakes with a fictional museum example, an animated film and a simple way to check claims against evidence.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Why does your phone stop charging at 80%?
item.description: A phone can pause at 80% because of a charge limit, its learned routine or heat. Check the setting and the conditions around the pause to tell the causes apart.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How satellite messaging works without cell towers
item.description: Trace a phone message through a satellite to a ground station. See why delivery can take longer than a regular text and how sky visibility affects the connection.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI property valuation: what an estimate misses
item.description: When two AI estimates disagree on a home's value, start with the facts each used. Review the sale dates, comparable homes and uncertainty before relying on a figure.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI in real estate decisions: where AI should stop
item.description: AI can prepare real estate information; people must verify material claims and explain uncertainty before a client decides. Use an explicit review handoff.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Two batteries, one foldable phone: how the battery reading works
item.description: See how two batteries power a folding phone with one charge indicator. Different cell capacities explain why averaging the two percentages can mislead you.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Humanoid robots at home: demos, shipments and autonomy
item.description: What does a humanoid robot shipment tell you about its ability to work at home? Compare deliveries, demonstrations and evidence of autonomous household tasks.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How to check an image claim, AI-made or not
item.description: Trace a photo back to its source, try a reverse image search and compare independent evidence. Learn what provenance can tell you when a photo is called AI-made.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI agent safety: boundaries before actions
item.description: Define which accounts, data and tools an AI agent can access. See where permissions are enforced, when a person approves an action and how to revoke access.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How ZIP files work: compression without losing data
item.description: See how lossless ZIP compression stores repeating data and rebuilds the original file. Find out why a folder of photos or videos may shrink very little.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How passkeys work: why Face ID is not your password
item.description: Face ID unlocks a passkey locally. Follow a sign-in to see how the site checks the cryptographic proof, where your face data stays and how recovery fits in.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Connected AI apps: access, scope and approval
item.description: What can a connected AI app read or change? Use examples from ChatGPT and Gemini to check the account, the scope of access and the actions that require approval.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Jev: an AI decision model, not another chatbot
item.description: See how TypeSafe describes Jev, how it picks from a bounded set of outcomes and what you need to check before a model's decision can route a business task.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: AI cost per accepted result
item.description: A practical framework for measuring the full cost of accepted AI workflow results.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: Start with the decision, then build the AI
item.description: A practical approach to AI product decisions: start with the customer’s decision, assess the evidence, and evaluate the whole workflow.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi
